description: Explicit gap classification and candidate methods; no automatic target access, installation, or proof

routes.input: Permitted docs, demos, feature evidence and prior cases
routes.method: Map actors and journeys, triangulate independent sources, mark inaccessible surfaces
routes.acceptance: Feature obligations with evidence and blocked inventory
routes.boundary: Do not infer absence from a missing observation

routes.input: Authorized screenshots, DOM snapshots, interaction traces and licensed assets
routes.method: Capture viewport/state matrix, measure design and motion, reproduce independently and compare
routes.acceptance: Visual, a11y and behavior checks across viewports

routes.input: Authorized shipped artifact or source, runtime classification
routes.method: Choose appropriate parser/provider; compare known source fixture and alternate analyzer
routes.boundary: No hidden source or unauthorized artifacts

routes.input: Published specs, sanitized permitted samples and owned mock/sandbox
routes.method: Infer types, version schema, mock and test independent implementation including errors

routes.input: Lawful examples or exports and observed lifecycle
routes.method: Derive candidate schema/constraints, round trip and test migrations/constraints in disposable DB
routes.boundary: Physical remote database schema remains unknown

routes.input: Published scopes and authorized role fixtures
routes.method: Model access matrix, verify deny-by-default, revocation and tenant isolation in own implementation
routes.acceptance: Every critical role/action tested, no unauthorized disclosure

routes.input: Permitted input/output observations; own instrumentable program for Daikon
routes.method: Compare state/decision hypotheses; trace likely invariants; solve constraints; test held-out normal and edge cases
routes.boundary: Likely invariants are not proven source logic

routes.input: Official action/trigger/scope docs and approved provider sandbox
routes.method: Map each integration contract, test connection, actions, webhooks, retries and disconnect
routes.boundary: Provider secrets and private agreements unavailable

routes.method: Compare competing architectures, build minimal independent fixture, instrument own services
routes.boundary: No claim of original server source

routes.input: Task requirements, lawful independent datasets and benchmark
routes.method: Specify outcome, compare independent candidates, hold out examples and evaluate cost/quality
routes.acceptance: Scoped outcome equivalence or superior performance
routes.boundary: No model extraction or guaranteed original algorithm

routes.input: Licensed/consented/synthetic task data and independent evaluation set
routes.method: Build data card, dedupe, split by entity/time, evaluate task performance and human review

routes.description: AI agent decision and memory behavior
routes.input: Documented tools, authorized transcripts or synthetic scenarios
routes.method: Define tasks, assess repeated success/latency/cost, permissions, recovery and state persistence
routes.boundary: No hidden prompt or model extraction

routes.input: Authorized ordered event logs or owned traces
routes.method: Normalize events; discover process model; validate conformance and model bounded retries/concurrency
routes.acceptance: Replay and invariant/liveness checks with explicit model bounds

routes.description: Unknown file or binary data format
routes.input: Authorized binary fixtures, format documentation, license
routes.method: Create independent declarative grammar, compile parser, compare known outputs and malformed sample behavior locally
routes.boundary: Not automatic format recovery; no bypass

routes.input: Owned or explicitly load-authorized environment, representative workload and budget
routes.method: Freeze workload and SLO, compare candidate architectures, measure latency/errors/resource use
routes.boundary: Never load-test third-party target without explicit authorization

routes.input: Approved environment, infrastructure requirements and pinned service images
routes.method: Reproduce dependencies in disposable fixtures, test migrations, restore and rollback; evaluate hosting
routes.boundary: No inference of original hosting internals

routes.description: Undocumented edge cases and failure paths
routes.input: Independent implementation and explicit allowed input domains
routes.method: Generate properties and stateful tests, shrink failures, add regression cases
routes.boundary: No automated probing of unapproved systems

routes.input: Opt-in data or synthetic graph and consent constraints
routes.method: Model independent network cold start, evaluate representative matching objectives
routes.acceptance: Quality and privacy metrics on lawful data
routes.boundary: Original users and relationship history cannot be reproduced

routes.input: Own or licensed code, compatible recipe and baseline tests
routes.method: Dry-run recipe, review diff, execute only approved change, regression and rollback
routes.acceptance: Equivalent accepted behavior and improved measured property
routes.boundary: No copying proprietary source; recipe/license constraints
